title: NSSS Leaves
description: Adds the leaves behavior from NSSS into BTA!
body:
Adds the leaves behavior from NSSS into BTA! Items now fall through leaves, and leaves can be broken quicker with a sword.
Note: This does not make leaves change their texture according to seasons like NSSS does. Required on Client and Server!
(If you're playing on a server with NSSS Leaves installed on it, the mod isn't strictly required on the client but it's a lot less janky looking if it is installed)
